transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… it’s eating stuff. Late at night mostly. I’ll start picking at food and tell myself, “That’s enough, Santiago,” but then my hand just keeps going back. Feels like I’m not really the one deciding anymore.
Do you feel guilty after these late-night eating episodes?
I don’t know… maybe sometimes. I try not to think about it too much after.
Do you ever eat an amount of food that is definitely larger than what most people would eat in a similar time period?

Yeah… I think so. Some nights after work I’ll end up eating a lot more than I meant to. Like several tamales, a big bowl of pozole, tortillas… then whatever rice or beans are still there. I kind of tell myself I’m just cleaning up leftovers, but… it’s a lot.
Do you feel like you're unable to stop eating or control how much you're eating during those late-night episodes?

Yeah… that’s kind of the part that bothers me. Once I start picking at it, I’ll tell myself, like, “That’s enough, Santiago,” but then… my hand just keeps going back. Like I’m not really choosing it anymore.
Do you feel like you're in control of what you're eating during those episodes?
Not really. I mean… once I start picking at it, I’ll tell myself that’s enough, but then I keep going back anyway. It feels like I’m not the one deciding at that point.
Do you have times where you eat and feel like you can't stop or are out of control?

Yeah… that’s what worries me. Like late at night, once I start picking at the food, I’ll tell myself, “That’s enough, Santiago,” but… my hand just keeps going back. It feels like I don’t really get to decide anymore.
Do you usually feel stressed or anxious before these late-night eating episodes happen?
I don’t know… I haven’t really paid attention to that. Maybe sometimes, but I can’t say for sure.
Do you feel stressed or anxious right before you start eating late at night?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed it being right before, exactly… I guess I just end up eating.
Do you feel upset or distressed about the way you're eating late at night?
I mean… I don’t feel great about it. It’s embarrassing, I guess. I try not to think too much about it after.
Do you feel like you're eating really fast during those late-night episodes?
Yeah… I guess I do. It’s not like eating dinner with my family. I kind of just eat it fast, like I’m trying to finish before anyone wakes up. I don’t really taste much of it.
Do you feel like you're able to pause or stop eating once you've started during those late-night episodes?
Yeah… that’s kind of the part that bothers me. I’ll tell myself, like, okay, that’s enough, Santiago… but then my hand just keeps going back. It feels like I’m not really the one deciding anymore.
Do you often feel guilty or bad about yourself after these late-night eating episodes?
I don’t know… maybe sometimes. I try not to sit there thinking about it too much. It’s not exactly a good feeling, but… yeah, I don’t really know what to call it.
Do you ever eat so automatically that you don't even remember eating?
I don’t think so… I mean, I remember doing it. Maybe it feels kind of automatic, but I wouldn’t say I forget it happened.
Do you feel like you're eating more quickly than usual during those episodes because you feel like you can't stop?
Yeah… I do eat fast. Not like at dinner with my family. It’s more like I’m trying to get it over with before anyone wakes up, so I’m barely even tasting it.
Do you ever find food missing or evidence of eating, but you don't remember eating it?
No… I don’t think so. If something’s missing, I usually know I was the one who ate it. I haven’t found wrappers or anything and not remembered.
Do you ever feel like you're in a trance or a daze while you're eating during those late-night episodes?
I’m not sure I’d call it a trance. I’m kind of zoned in on what I’m doing, I guess… but I know what’s happening.
Do you think you eat more when you're feeling stressed, anxious, or upset?
I don’t know… maybe sometimes. I haven’t really paid close attention to whether it’s stress or anything like that.
Do you usually eat late at night when you're feeling upset or emotional?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed a clear pattern like that… sometimes it’s just late and I end up eating.
Do you think your late-night eating happens because you're feeling upset or emotional?
I don’t really know. I mean, I guess it could be sometimes, but I haven’t noticed it being because I’m upset exactly. It just… happens late.
Do you think your late-night eating is usually triggered by feeling upset or emotional?
I can’t really say it’s usually that. I haven’t paid enough attention to call it emotional… it just kind of happens sometimes.
